info.title: HirePulse Apify Data Tools API
info.description: Input contracts for eight HirePulse data tools running on Apify. Provide an Apify token using the Authorization: Bearer header. Every call must specify maxTotalChargeUsd, up to the $1 limit documented here. This synchronous API can time out after 300 seconds; a timeout or lost connection does not prove the Actor stopped. Check the existing run in Apify Console before starting another paid run. https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-sync-get-dataset-items-post

post.description:
Company-domain hiring, Google ads, estimated organic traffic, email provider and intent score from 0 to 100. $0.03 per company report, charged only when the full report is produced. Free plan: hiring and email signals for up to 5 companies, not 5 free runs.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-intent-radar

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: Company Intent Radar input
schema.description: List company websites. Each one gets a short report of buying-intent signals: hiring, Google ads, SEO traffic and email provider.

domains.title: Company domains
domains.description: Required. Company websites, one per item, up to 100 per run. Full URLs are fine too. Example: ["stripe.com", "notion.so"]. Returns one report per domain.

country.title: Country for SEO traffic
country.description: Two-letter ISO country code used for the organic SEO traffic estimate. Example: "GB". Default: "US".

include_jobs.title: Include newest job titles
include_jobs.description: Add the 5 newest job titles to each report. Default: false, which keeps reports short.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description:
Google ads by company domain: advertiser, format, first/last shown dates, preview images and Transparency Center links. Ad text is not returned. $0.005 per domain + $0.0015 per ad; domains with no ads cost $0. Summary mode returns one row per domain, with no per-ad charge.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper input
schema.description: List the website domains of the companies you want to check. For each one you get the ads it runs on Google (Search, YouTube, Shopping, Play, Maps), from Google's Ads Transparency Center.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Required. Company websites, one per item, up to 100 per run. Full URLs are fine too. Example: ["nike.com", "adidas.com"]. Results include every advertiser whose ads lead to the domain, not only the brand itself.

mode.title: Output
mode.description: "ads": one record per ad (advertiser, format, first and last shown dates, preview and transparency links). "summary": one compact record per domain (runs_google_ads, total_ads, formats, advertisers, latest ad), charged per domain only, and domains without ads are free; best for lead lists and AI agents. Default: "ads". For a cheap agent check use mode="summary" with one domain. For an ad sample use mode="ads" and max_ads_per_domain=1.

max_ads_per_domain.title: Max ads per domain
max_ads_per_domain.description: Ads mode only: most recent ads to return per domain, 1 to 120. Each returned ad is one charged result. Default: 40. For a cheap agent check use mode="summary" with one domain. For an ad sample use mode="ads" and max_ads_per_domain=1.

country.title: Country
country.description: Only ads shown in this country, as a two-letter ISO code. Example: "US", "GB" or "DE". Leave empty for ads shown in any country.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Only ads shown on this Google platform: "all", "google_search", "youtube", "google_shopping", "google_play" or "google_maps". Default: "all".

format.title: Ad format
format.description: Only ads of this format: "all", "text", "image" or "video". Default: "all".

date_from.title: Shown from
date_from.description: Only ads shown on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "2026-09-01". Set together with date_to. Optional.

date_to.title: Shown until
date_to.description: Only ads shown on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "2026-09-30". Optional.

only_new_ads.title: Only new ads (monitoring)
only_new_ads.description: Return only ads that your earlier runs did not return yet, for the same domain and filters (remembered in your own Apify account). Use it with a daily or weekly schedule to monitor new competitor ads. The per-domain fee still applies when the domain runs ads, even if none of them is new. Default: false.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description:
Extract open jobs, published salary ranges and technologies from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee and SmartRecruiters (Workday not supported). Pay per result on Apify Store.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: ATS-Job-Pulse input
schema.description: Give a list of companies. For each one the Actor finds its job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters), returns the open jobs plus a hiring summary, and reports what changed since the previous run. Use the filters to keep the output small.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Required. Company website domains or job-board slugs, one per item. Example: ["stripe.com", "linear.app"]. The job board is detected automatically on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee and SmartRecruiters (not Workday). To force a board, prefix the slug: "greenhouse:stripe", "lever:spotify", "ashby:linear", "workable:huggingface", "recruitee:bunq", "smartrecruiters:BoschGroup". Charged once per company found, whatever its job count.

output_mode.title: What to return
output_mode.description: Which records to return. "summary_only": one company_summary per company (job counts, new and closed counts, departments, locations, technologies); the smallest output, best for AI agents. "jobs_and_summary": the summary plus every job record. "jobs_only": job records only. Default: "jobs_and_summary". For a cheap agent check use output_mode="summary_only" and max_jobs_per_company=20. This keeps returned data small; the per-company charge is unchanged.

track_diff.title: Track changes between runs
track_diff.description: Compare with the previous run that used the same state_id and set each job's status to NEW, EXISTING or CLOSED. The first run marks every job NEW (is_first_run = true). When false, every job is ACTIVE and nothing is saved. Default: true.

state_id.title: State ID
state_id.description: Name of the saved history for change tracking. Runs with the same state_id are compared with each other; history is kept per company. Use one value per watchlist or schedule. Example: "eng-watchlist". Default: "default_state".

extract_tech_keywords.title: Extract technology keywords
extract_tech_keywords.description: Detect core technologies (Python, AWS, React, Kubernetes, LLMs, ...) in each job title and description, and return them in detected_technologies and in the summary's top_technologies. Default: true.

only_changes.title: Only new and closed jobs
only_changes.description: Return only jobs whose status is NEW or CLOSED. Use it on scheduled runs with a fixed state_id to get just what changed since the last run. Default: false.

title_keywords.title: Job title contains
title_keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains any of these words or phrases (case-insensitive). Example: ["engineer", "data scientist"]. Filters reduce the job records only; the summary always counts all jobs.

departments.title: Department contains
departments.description: Keep only jobs whose department contains any of these words (case-insensitive). Example: ["engineering", "sales"].

locations.title: Location contains
locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains any of these words (case-insensitive). Example: ["london", "new york", "germany"].

technologies.title: Mentions technology
technologies.description: Keep only jobs that mention any of these technologies, using the names returned in detected_technologies (case-insensitive). Example: ["Python", "Kubernetes", "LLMs"].

remote_only.title: Remote jobs only
remote_only.description: Keep only jobs marked or described as remote. Default: false.

max_jobs_per_company.title: Max jobs per company
max_jobs_per_company.description: Maximum job records per company, after the other filters. 0 = no limit. When the limit applies, NEW jobs are kept first, then CLOSED, then the rest; the summary's matching_jobs gives the full count. Example: 20. Default: 0. For a cheap agent check use output_mode="summary_only" and max_jobs_per_company=20. This keeps returned data small; the per-company charge is unchanged.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description:
Google Jobs results in 90+ countries with parsed salaries, contract types and apply URLs. $0.005 per search with jobs + $0.001 per job.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: Google Jobs Scraper input
schema.description: Search Google's job listings (Google Jobs) for any job title or keyword, in any supported country or city. Returns title, company, location, salary, contract type, posting date and the link to apply.

queries.title: Job searches
queries.description: Required. Job searches as you would type them into Google, one per item, up to 50 per run. Example: ["data engineer", "nurse night shift"]. To get every job of one company, hirepulse/ats-job-pulse is the better fit.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country as a two-letter ISO code (e.g. US, GB, DE, AE). 94 countries are supported; the 20 most used are listed first. Default: "US".

location.title: City or region (optional)
location.description: A city or region inside the country, written as "City,Region". Example: "Austin,Texas" or "London,England". Leave empty to search the whole country.

radius_km.title: Radius around the city (km)
radius_km.description: With a location only: search up to this many kilometers around it, 1 to 300. Example: 40. Leave empty for the city's default area.

max_jobs_per_query.title: Maximum jobs per search
max_jobs_per_query.description: Jobs to return per search, 1 to 200. Each returned job is one charged result. Example: 100. Default: 50.

employment_types.title: Employment types (optional)
employment_types.description: Only these contract types: "fulltime", "partime", "contractor" or "intern". Example: ["fulltime"]. Leave empty for all. For part-time jobs use the literal "partime". This spelling is required by the Actor code; "parttime" is not accepted.

include_descriptions.title: Add full job descriptions
include_descriptions.description: Add the full description text for jobs whose apply link is on a Workday, Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board; other jobs keep only apply_url. No extra charge; turn off for faster runs. Default: true.

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language code. Leave empty for the country's main language. Example: "es" with country "US". Countries with more than one language: US: en/es; CA: en/fr; IN: en/hi; DZ: fr/ar; BE: fr/nl/de; CY: el/en; EG: ar/en; GR: el/en; HK: en/zh-TW; ID: en/id; IL: he/ar; MY: en/ms; MA: ar/fr; PK: en/ur; PH: en/tl; SG: en/zh-CN; CH: de/fr/it; UA: uk/ru; AE: ar/en; VN: en/vi.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description:
Google monthly search volume, CPC, competition and keyword ideas. $0.03 per lookup + $0.005 per keyword result. Free preview availability can be paused.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/keyword-search-volume

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: Keyword Search Volume & Ideas input
schema.description: Get Google search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and search intent for keywords, or discover new keyword ideas from seed keywords.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Required. In "metrics" mode: the exact keywords to measure (up to 5,000). In "ideas" mode: seed keywords describing a topic (up to 200). In "suggestions" mode: seed phrases to expand into long-tail keywords (up to 20). Each keyword: max 80 characters and 10 words. Example: ["keyword research tool", "ai agents"].

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "metrics": metrics for exactly the keywords given (one lookup per 700 keywords). "ideas": keywords related to the seeds as a group, most relevant first (one lookup). "suggestions": long-tail keywords that contain each seed phrase, highest search volume first (one lookup per seed). Default: "metrics".

country.title: Country
country.description: Country as a two-letter ISO code (e.g. US, GB, DE, AE). 94 countries are supported; the 20 most used are listed first. Default: "US".

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language code. Leave empty for the country's main language. Example: "es" with country "US". Countries with more than one language: US: en/es; CA: en/fr; IN: en/hi; DZ: fr/ar; BE: fr/nl/de; CY: el/en; EG: ar/en; GR: el/en; HK: en/zh-TW; ID: en/id; IL: he/ar; MY: en/ms; MA: ar/fr; PK: en/ur; PH: en/tl; SG: en/zh-CN; CH: de/fr/it; UA: uk/ru; AE: ar/en; VN: en/vi.

max_results.title: Max results
max_results.description: Only for "ideas" and "suggestions": maximum keywords to return (per seed in "suggestions" mode), 1 to 1,000. Each returned keyword with metrics is one charged result. Example: 30. Default: 50.

min_search_volume.title: Minimum monthly search volume
min_search_volume.description: Return only keywords with at least this many monthly searches. Keywords below it are not returned and not charged. Example: 100. Default: 0 (no minimum).

include_monthly_searches.title: Include 12-month history
include_monthly_searches.description: Add a monthly_searches array with the search volume of each of the last 12 months. Default: false, which keeps the output small.

include_ai_search_volume.title: Include AI search volume
include_ai_search_volume.description: Also return ai_search_volume, an estimate of how often each keyword is used in AI assistants per month. Costs one extra lookup per batch plus one result for every keyword with AI data; where the data is not available, the field stays null and nothing extra is charged. Default: false.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description: Public-evidence preview: website metadata, sitemap observations and autocomplete suggestions. No measured organic traffic, rankings, search volumes or CPC in native mode. Null database fields are not estimates. Native lookup/result events are not charged; Actor start fees still apply. Review live pricing. https://apify.com/hirepulse/domain-seo-overview

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: Domain SEO Overview input
schema.description: Get the estimated Google organic traffic, the number of ranking keywords, the top keywords and the organic competitors of any website.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Required. Websites to analyze, one per item, up to 100 per run. Full URLs are reduced to the domain. Example: ["stripe.com", "adyen.com"].

country.title: Country
country.description: Country as a two-letter ISO code (e.g. US, GB, DE, AE). 94 countries are supported; the 20 most used are listed first. Default: "US".

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language code. Leave empty for the country's main language. Example: "es" with country "US". Countries with more than one language: US: en/es; CA: en/fr; IN: en/hi; DZ: fr/ar; BE: fr/nl/de; CY: el/en; EG: ar/en; GR: el/en; HK: en/zh-TW; ID: en/id; IL: he/ar; MY: en/ms; MA: ar/fr; PK: en/ur; PH: en/tl; SG: en/zh-CN; CH: de/fr/it; UA: uk/ru; AE: ar/en; VN: en/vi.

top_keywords.title: Top keywords per domain
top_keywords.description: Ranking keywords to return per domain (organic positions 1 to 20, highest search volume first), 0 to 1,000. 0 skips this lookup and its fee: use 0 for a cheap overview only. Each returned keyword is one charged result. Default: 20. For a cheap agent check use top_keywords=0 and competitors=0 to request only the overview, without the keyword and competitor lookups.

competitors.title: Competitors per domain
competitors.description: Organic competitors to return per domain (sites ranking for the same keywords, most shared keywords first), 0 to 100. 0 skips this lookup and its fee. Each returned competitor is one charged result. Default: 10. For a cheap agent check use top_keywords=0 and competitors=0 to request only the overview, without the keyword and competitor lookups.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description:
YouTube video and Shorts transcripts with timestamps. Free Apify plan: the first 3 videos of each run. See the Store page for pricing.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: YouTube Transcript Scraper input
schema.description: Give a list of YouTube videos and get the transcript of each one as clean text, with optional timestamps.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Required. YouTube video URLs or 11-character video IDs, one per item, up to 1,000 per run. Regular links, youtu.be links, Shorts, embeds and live links all work. Example: ["https://youtu.be/jNQXAC9IVRw"]. Each delivered transcript is one charged result; videos without captions are not charged.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: Preferred caption language as a two-letter code. Example: "es". If the video has captions in it they are used; otherwise the main captions are returned and the language field says which. Leave empty for the main captions.

include_timestamps.title: Include timestamps
include_timestamps.description: Add a segments array with the start time, duration and text of every caption line. Default: false, which keeps the output small.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

post.description:
AliExpress search results with product title, price, discount, rating, sold count, image and product link. No seller name, shipping cost or delivery estimate, reviews or stock data. $2.50 per 1,000 products. Free Apify plan: 100 products per run.
Apify Store Page: https://apify.com/hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper

parameters.name: maxTotalChargeUsd
parameters.description: Maximum total Actor run charge in USD. Required by this contract, capped at $1. A cap can produce partial results.

schema.title: AliExpress Search Scraper input
schema.description: Search AliExpress like a shopper and get every product in the results as structured data.

queries.title: Searches
queries.description: Required. AliExpress search keywords, one per item, up to 20 per run. Example: ["yoga mat", "usb c cable"]. Keyword searches only; product page URLs are not supported.

max_results_per_query.title: Max products per search
max_results_per_query.description: Products to return per search, 1 to 1,200 (60 per page, up to 20 pages). Each returned product is one charged result. Free Apify plan: 100 products per run. Default: 60.

sort.title: Sort by
sort.description: Result order: "best_match" (AliExpress default), "orders" (most orders first, best for finding what sells), "price_low" or "price_high". Default: "best_match".

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of all prices, one of the listed codes. Example: "EUR". Default: "USD".

ship_to.title: Ship to country
ship_to.description: Delivery country as a two-letter ISO code. Prices and availability follow it, as on the website. Example: "DE". Default: "US".

min_price.title: Min price
min_price.description: Only products priced at or above this value, as a whole number. Example: 5. Optional.

max_price.title: Max price
max_price.description: Only products priced at or below this value, as a whole number. Example: 50. Optional; must not be below min_price.

200.description: Synchronous run completed and dataset items returned as a JSON array

408.description: Synchronous HTTP timeout. Check the existing run in Apify Console; do not automatically start another paid run.

ApifyBearer.description: Secret Apify API token. Supply it only in the Authorization header; never in a URL.
